title: Window signature and hours
slide_intent: Combine identification and practical information so a visitor can recognize the place and understand access.
strategic_value: A clean window signature can keep Sweetgreen legible while letting the interior’s plants and materials contribute character.
demonstration: White sweetgreen lettering and smaller hours information appear on glass over a cactus and warm interior; small line symbols sit below.
practical_value: Set an information hierarchy that survives reflections and a visually active interior.

content_islands.name: Window lettering
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark above smaller operational text and symbols.

content_islands.name: Interior context
content_islands.spec: Retain cactus, seating and reflections behind the lettering.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity and visitor information are applied to transparent storefront glass.
